profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit open-source foundation based around Blender, which it describes as free and open-source 3D creation software. The software covers a broad range of creative workflows including rendering, rigging, animation, camera and object tracking, Grease Pencil drawing in 3D viewports, and material and asset management. The foundation also operates Blender Studio, which produces original film projects, including a recently announced feature film called OVERGROWN, and publishes free training such as the Blender Fundamentals series. Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and receives hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks a category of third-party and community-developed plugins called Blender AI Add-ons, described as 3D creation AI plugins that run with local processing and are open-source, with model provenance varying by plugin. The upcoming Blender 5.2 LTS release, mentioned on the site, includes features such as a Cycles Texture Cache for more memory-efficient rendering of scenes with many image textures, new Grease Pencil textured brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library with customizable procedural materials. The foundation's Python API and the broader add-on ecosystem form the primary pathway through which AI-related tooling reaches Blender users. No litigation, patent filings, or SEC records are held for this organization.
